The provided text is the famous opening of Franz Kafka's *The Metamorphosis* (*Die Verwandlung*). Its central premise—a traveling salesman waking up to find himself transformed into a giant insect, yet worrying primarily about being late for work and dealing with his boss—is one of the most uniquely original, unpredictable, and groundbreaking concepts in literary history.
